{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensor pads''' were motion activated [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. They were used at the [[HyperDive Cantina]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. When a patron entered the HyperDive through a long dark tube, passing the sensor pads, it activated motion lighting that gave the individual the sense they were travelling through a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
